## Award RFQ (Ar)

The single writer for the RFQ → PO transition. Re-enforces both award gates (stale quote, lapsed compliance), stamps the PO number (snapshot), computes the threshold route from the quote total (auto <$1k / Manager <$10k / Finance→VP ≥$10k), generates pending chain steps, copies the winning lines, and marks the RFQ awarded. An auto-route PO is approved immediately and committed against the budget; larger POs commit on final approval instead.

### Example

Natural target: the linked RFQ "Q1 Laptop Refresh" with two live quotes to choose between.

### Non-goals

No decline notifications to losing vendors (v1.1 text generation). No partial awards / line splitting across vendors.
